title: Improving the Bounds on Approximating Weighted Maximin Share for Chores
abstract: arXiv:2610.15520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate the problem of allocating indivisible chores among agents with arbitrary positive weights and additive nonnegative cost functions. An allocation is said to be $\alpha$-weighted-maximin-share (WMMS) fair if the cost incurred by each agent is at most $\alpha$ times her weighted maximin share. We establish that every instance admits a $4.124234528$-WMMS allocation. Moreover, for instances in which all weights and costs are rational numbers represented in binary, we give an algorithm that computes a $4.12424$-WMMS allocation in time polynomial in the number of agents, the number of chores, and the total binary encoding length of the input. Complementing these upper bounds, we construct a family of instances with strictly positive, identically ordered costs for which the optimal WMMS approximation factors converge to $e$. translated_title: 改进家务分配中加权最大最小份额的近似界限
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在具有任意正权重和可加非负成本函数的智能体之间分配不可分家务的问题。如果一个分配使得每个智能体承担的成本至多为其加权最大最小份额的 α 倍，则称该分配是 α-加权最大最小份额公平的。我们证明了每个实例都存在 4.124234528-WMMS 分配。此外，对于所有权重和成本均为二进制表示的有理数的实例，我们给出了一个可在关于智能体数量、家务数量以及输入总二进制编码长度的多项式时间内计算出 4.12424-WMMS 分配的算法。作为对这些上界的补充，我们构造了一族具有严格为正且同序成本的实例，其最优 WMMS 近似比收敛于 e。综上，我们的结果显著缩小了由 Li 等人先前建立的 [2,12] 这一已知最佳差距。
tldr: 本文证明了任意实例均存在约4.124的加权最大最小份额公平分配并给出多项式时间算法，同时构造出最优近似比收敛于 e 的实例下界，从而将先前已知的 [2,12] 差距大幅缩小。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that every instance admits an approximately 4.124-WMMS allocation together with a polynomial-time algorithm, and constructs a family of instances whose optimal WMMS approximation ratio converges to e, substantially narrowing the previously known [2,12] gap for weighted maximin share fairness in chore allocation.
